spaces.description: The spaces to evaluate; without it, the default space. A query whose spaces are not all among these is skipped, never run

queries.description: The query set: <collection>/<path> under each space's collection of that name, JSON Lines of eval-queries.v1; default eval/queries.jsonl

k.description: The cut-off of recall, nDCG and MRR, and the hits each query is run for

expand.description: Run with graph expansion on, off or both; the gate needs both
